explication: Buildah is a daemonless tool and Go API for constructing OCI or Docker-format container images. A typical user workflow starts from a base image or scratch, applies Containerfile/Dockerfile instructions or direct container operations, configures the result, then commits it as an image. The README also documents image transfer and local container/image management. The sampled sources show command initialization, build execution, filesystem copying, and Linux isolation; other command relationships below rely on README descriptions, not inspection of their implementations.
